For example, 22240 is in <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: 0;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1.928ex" height="1.545ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -683 852 683" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="1D44B" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D44B"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container> while 02244 and 44422 are not in <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: 0;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1.928ex" height="1.545ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -683 852 683" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="1D44B" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D44B"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container>. Suppose that each element of <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: 0;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1.928ex" height="1.545ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -683 852 683" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="1D44B" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D44B"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container> has an equal chance of being chosen. Let <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: -0.439ex;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1.138ex" height="1.439ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -442 503 636" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="1D45D" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D45D"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container> be the conditional probability that an element chosen at random is a multiple of 20 given that it is a multiple of 5 .
